title: Recording: Everybody Wins, Angel In Disguise by Ringo Starr | 1991
content:
Studio F, Los Angeles
Producer: Peter Asher
Engineer: Frank Wolf

Ringo Starr finished recording two outtakes from his tenth solo album, Time Takes Time, on 18 September 1991.

‘Everybody Wins’ was released on the ‘Don’t Go Where The Road Don’t Go’ CD single in September 1992. Starr re-recorded the song for 2010’s Y Not, retitling it ‘Everyone Wins’.

The song was recorded on 10, 11, and 12 September, and completed on this day. It was released on the ‘Don’t Go Where The Road Don’t Go’ CD single in September the following year.

Also worked on was ‘Angel In Disguise’, a co-write by Starr and Paul McCartney. It had been started on 9 September, with overdubs added on 12, 13 September and this day, but the song was left unreleased.
